accepted.label: GloVe: Global Vectors for Word Representation (Implementation)
accepted.description: Understanding how GloVe uses a co-occurrence matrix to generate word embeddings and contrasting with Word2Vec's local window approach, with an implementation focus.
coverage_criteria: Explain how GloVe uses a co-occurrence matrix to learn word embeddings.
Compare GloVe's approach to Word2Vec's context-window method.
accepted.merge_rationale: Standalone concept with implementation depth, distinct from math-focused explanation.

accepted.label: GloVe: Global Vectors for Word Representation (Math)
accepted.description: Understanding the mathematical formulation of GloVe, where vectors are trained such that their dot product approximates the log of co-occurrence probability, incorporating global statistics.
coverage_criteria: Explain how GloVe differs from Word2vec regarding global information.
Describe the role of the co‑occurrence matrix in GloVe.
accepted.merge_rationale: Standalone concept with math depth, distinct from implementation explanation.
